reliability.crash.toastTitle: Agent Pets hit an internal error
reliability.crash.toastBody: The error was contained and the app keeps running. If your pet stops responding, reload it from the menu.
reliability.startup.failedMessage: Some services could not start. You can restart Agent Pets or quit for now.
reliability.renderer.gaveUpTitle: The pet view could not recover
reliability.renderer.gaveUpBody: Automatic reloads kept failing. Choose "Reload pet" from the menu or restart Agent Pets.
reliability.server.portBusyBody: Local port {port} is held by another program, so agent events cannot arrive. Close the old Agent Pets or the program using it.
reliability.server.failedBody: Local port {port} could not start, so agent events cannot arrive. Check system permissions or firewall settings.
reliability.server.bannerBusy: Port {port} is in use; retrying automatically.
reliability.server.bannerBusyAgentPets: Port {port} is held by another Agent Pets. Close it first.
reliability.unclean.title: Agent Pets did not exit cleanly last time
reliability.unclean.body: If your pet crashed or stopped responding, export diagnostics from Settings > Advanced.
reliability.diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
reliability.diagnostics.help: Export versions, system info and recent error logs for bug reports. Saved locally only, with tokens, prompts and personal paths removed; nothing is uploaded.
reliability.renderer.errorMessage: Something went wrong in this view.
reliability.server.summaryBusy: {count} local service ports are in use; retrying automatically
reliability.history.recoveredBody: The history database was damaged. A backup copy was kept and a new database was created; history will build up again from now.
reliability.launch.pending: macOS needs you to approve Agent Pets in System Settings → General → Login Items.
reliability.launch.notInApplications: Move Agent Pets to the Applications folder first, then turn this on. macOS will not register a login item for an app run from a disk image or Downloads.
reliability.launch.error: Could not change launch at login. Try again later or check System Settings.
reliability.crash.escalateMessage: Unexpected errors keep occurring in the background. Restarting Agent Pets is recommended; you can also keep running.
